name: Automatic Ratings
author: Automatic Ratings contributors
description: Generate per-user album and artist ratings independently from user-rated songs.

subsonicapi.reason: Read song ratings and update only album and artist ratings for assigned users.

users.reason: Calculate ratings separately for assigned users.

library.reason: Restrict scans to explicitly granted libraries, intersected with each user's access.

scheduler.reason: Run daily and serialize bounded continuation callbacks.

kvstore.reason: Persist source snapshots, checkpoints, summaries, and rating ownership with write intents.

skip_unrated_users.title: Skip unrated users when no rating needs changing
skip_unrated_users.description: Use validated paginated song/artist reads to skip users with no rated songs and no eligible clears. Incomplete results or ratings requiring evaluation fall back to the full scan. Audit logging uses a full scan.

audit_logging.title: Log source evidence for independent verification
audit_logging.description: Log calculation settings, raw structured artist IDs, song IDs/ratings, and item outcomes at info level. Enables full scans and can produce large logs containing private library metadata. Use scripts/verify-audit.py to verify a complete run locally.

rate_artists.title: Generate artist ratings directly from songs

artist_attribution.title: Artist attribution
artist_attribution.description: Album artist uses all structured album-artist credits. Performing artist uses structured song-artist credits; names are never split.

album_rating_policy.title: Album rating policy
album_rating_policy.description: Preserve protects existing unmanaged ratings and detected manual edits, while refreshing this plugin's output. Replace explicitly permits overwriting existing ratings and adopting matching results. No initial wipe is performed.

artist_rating_policy.title: Artist rating policy
artist_rating_policy.description: Preserve protects existing unmanaged ratings and detected manual edits, while refreshing this plugin's output. Replace explicitly permits overwriting existing ratings and adopting matching results. No initial wipe is performed.

dry_run.title: Preview without changing ratings
dry_run.description: Preview both independent outputs. Ownership records are not changed in dry runs.

album_clear_below_threshold.title: Clear album ratings below quota
album_clear_below_threshold.description: Clear eligible ratings only after validating the complete source. Preserve policy protects unmanaged/manual ratings. Artists require a complete, rechecked source scan. Empty sources never trigger clearing.

album_minimum_rated_percent.title: Album: minimum percentage of rated songs
album_minimum_rated_percent.description: Unrated songs count toward coverage but stay out of the mean. The percentage quota is rounded up.

album_minimum_rated_songs.title: Album: minimum number of rated songs
album_minimum_rated_songs.description: Both the percentage and count quota must be met.

artist_clear_below_threshold.title: Clear artist ratings below quota
artist_clear_below_threshold.description: Clear eligible ratings only after validating the complete source. Preserve policy protects unmanaged/manual ratings. Artists require a complete, rechecked source scan. Empty sources never trigger clearing.

artist_minimum_rated_percent.title: Artist: minimum percentage of rated songs
artist_minimum_rated_percent.description: Unrated songs count toward coverage but stay out of the mean. The percentage quota is rounded up.

artist_minimum_rated_songs.title: Artist: minimum number of rated songs
artist_minimum_rated_songs.description: Both the percentage and count quota must be met.

run_time_utc.title: Daily start time (UTC)
run_time_utc.description: Live callbacks can reschedule this time. Some Navidrome versions unload a plugin after configuration edits without reinitializing it; restart the server/container after edits if callbacks stop.

run_now.title: Request a scan now
run_now.description: Starts once on the next worker tick. Leaving true does not repeat scans, including after restart. To rearm, save false, let a worker tick observe it, then save true. Restart after edits on Navidrome versions that unload plugins without reinitializing.

batch_size.title: Work units per checkpoint
batch_size.description: Inventory pages, album reads, source checks, and artist evaluations are checkpointed in bounded batches; batches chain within a shared 20-second callback budget.

batch_interval_seconds.title: Seconds between continuation ticks
batch_interval_seconds.description: Delay before continuing unfinished work or checking manual requests. There is no interval sleep between chained batches.

detail_logging.title: Per-item audit logging
detail_logging.description: Info summaries are always emitted. Choose info to see every item without enabling server debug logging; this can be verbose. Errors remain visible even when item logging is off.
